item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `supported_params` with `response_format` and `supports_response_schema = True`, which is required to enter the schema-first path."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Harness forces first structured-output call to raise, then captures a second retry with `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}` and successful completion."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Checks the first `response_format` via `hasattr(first, \"model_json_schema\")`, showing it is a schema model/class rather than a plain dict."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts exactly two calls, second `response_format == {\"type\": \"json_object\"}`, and `result.answer == \"worked\"`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM` with `dspy.JSONAdapter()` and a canned JSON answer, so the example is offline and runnable."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Failure is one-shot: first call raises `RuntimeError`, second falls through to `DummyLM` and returns valid JSON."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
